text:
sam_fin: Heads up 1026-5589 from Julio (MX) hit our queue. Vendor is invoicing from a US LLC but work performed in Mexico. They're asking for payment net with Redwood grossing-up for any US withholding. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood.com/2026-5589.pdf

invoice-bot: Invoice 2026-5589 flagged: unclear tax status (W8 vs W9) and missing TRC/CFDI. Status: REVIEW_REQUIRED :warning:

julio_vendor: hi team, correct. we're Julio Creativo LLC (US EIN: 98-7654321) but all deliverables and payroll are Mexico-based. client contract says vendor will be made whole for taxes withheld. happy to provide docs.

nina_tax: Quick clarifying Qs: is the US LLC a disregarded entity for US tax? who is the actual payee (US bank acct name)? Treaty implications depend on legal payee/residency.

julio_vendor: payee name on bank acct: Julio Creativo LLC. bank in US (CHASE). the owner is a Mexican resident with RFC: JCRL800101ABC. we can supply W-9 and W-8BEN-E?

liam_legal: contract clause says "vendor to be indemnified for withholding" but not explicit gross-up mechanism. Legal needs to see the addendum that Julio referenced. please upload signed addendum.

sam_fin: Finance will hold payment until tax/legal confirm form and withholding. Action items: (1) vendor to provide proof of US entity status (EIN letter) and Mexican tax residency (TRC or local certificate) (2) legal to confirm whether clause mandates automatic gross-up (3) tax to confirm whether we should withhold US backup withholding or Mexican tax applies under treaty/rules.

julio_vendor: uploaded: EIN_Letter_2026-5589.pdf and RFC_Cert_2026-5589.pdf. I'll also upload gross-up addendum signed.

invoice-bot: New files uploaded: EIN_Letter_2026-5589.pdf, RFC_Cert_2026-5589.pdf by julio_vendor

nina_tax: preliminary: if payee is a US LLC that is the invoiced entity, US withholding generally not required on payments for services to a US entity, but backup withholding rules and Form W-9 needed. however, if beneficial owner is a non-US person and payments are effectively connected to Mexico, treaty considerations apply. we need TRC and confirmation of where services performed and where income is sourced.

liam_legal: also flag: payments routed to US bank might create nexus considerations. Contract language month ago had ambiguous "made whole" phrasing. legal prefers to negotiate a gross-up addendum with defined calculation rather than automatically grossing up.

sam_fin: noted. payment status -> ON_HOLD. tag: finance-approvals for budget impact if gross-up required.

julio_vendor: uploaded Grossup_Addendum_signed_2026-5589.pdf

invoice-bot: Payment status changed: PENDING_REVIEW -> ON_HOLD by sam_fin

nina_tax: next step for tax ops: we'll review TRC + RFC and EIN docs. If vendor is treated as US person for withholding (W-9), we need valid W-9; if non-US beneficial owner with TRC showing Mexican residency and treaty applies, withholding may be reduced. If contract mandates gross-up, finance/legal sign-off required before payment.

liam_legal: i'll draft a short addendum template to clarify gross-up calc and cap. will loop Julio for signature if needed.

sam_fin: thanks. keeping payment on hold 72hrs pending final tax/legal sign-off.

julio_vendor: understood. appreciate the clear list of docs. will standby and provide any extra evidence (CFDI) if needed.

invoice-bot: Thread note: "EIN + RFC uploaded; gross-up addendum received; tax & legal review pending. Payment ON_HOLD."
